_meta.description: ARGUS Phase 3 — per-CVE Mythos signal aggregates produced by `soc-argus-intel-mythos-aggregator`. The aggregator sums decayed, trust-weighted `.soc-intel-feed` rows per CVE over a 14-day window and caps the result at 1.0. The M2.3 exploit-probability path reads this index (keyed by `cve_id`) when computing `vulnerability.argus.exploit_context.mythos_signal` for an alert whose host did not produce Shadow-AI telemetry — it is the intel-feed-driven complement to the R13 Shadow-AI derivation in `@kbn/argus-exploit-probability`.
